message.content: Starting triage on the reported energy failure — shrinking it to isolate the cause.
Shrunk to a single free body — now confirming it reproduces and examining the trajectory.
Replay confirms the failure — pulling the step-by-step states to trace the energy growth.
I see spurious energy gain with no possible source — testing whether the large time step is responsible.
